#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long mod = 1000000007;

long long inv(long long n) {
    long long k = mod - 2;
    long long res = 1;
    long long a = n;
    while (k > 0) {
        if (k & 1) {
            res = (res * a) % mod;
        }
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        k >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

struct Node {
    int c50, c100, b, n;
    long long am;
    std::vector<Node*> s;
    Node(int x, int y, int z) : c50(x), c100(y), b(z), n(0), am(0) {
        s = std::vector<Node*>();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<long long> f(51, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < 51; i++) {
        f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % mod;
    }
    vector<vector<long long>> c(51, vector<long long>(51, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++) {
        c[i][0] = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
            c[i][j] = (f[i] * inv((f[j] * f[i - j]) % mod)) % mod;
        }
    }
    int c50 = 0, c100 = 0;
    vector<int> vals(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> vals[i];
        if (vals[i] == 100) c100++;
        else c50++;
    }
    vector<vector<vector<Node>>> ns(c50 + 1, vector<vector<Node>>(c100 + 1, vector<Node>(2, Node(0,0,0))));
    for (int i = 0; i <= c50; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= c100; j++) {
            ns[i][j][0] = Node(i, j, 0);
            ns[i][j][1] = Node(i, j, 1);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= c50; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= c100; j++) {
            int p50c = std::min(k / 50, i);
            int p100c = std::min(k / 100, j);
            for (int x = p100c; x >= 0; x--) {
                for (int y = std::min(p50c, (k - 100 * x) / 50); y >= 0; y--) {
                    if (y == 0 && x == 0) continue;
                    ns[i][j][0].s.push_back(&ns[i - y][j - x][1]);
                    ns[i - y][j - x][1].s.push_back(&ns[i][j][0]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    queue<Node*> q;
    ns[c50][c100][0].n = 1;
    ns[c50][c100][0].am = 1;
    q.push(&ns[c50][c100][0]);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        Node* cur = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (auto ch : cur->s) {
            if (ch->n == 0 || ch->n == cur->n + 1) {
                long long p1 = c[cur->b == 0 ? cur->c50 : c50 - cur->c50][abs(cur->c50 - ch->c50)];
                long long p2 = c[cur->b == 0 ? cur->c100 : c100 - cur->c100][abs(cur->c100 - ch->c100)];
                ch->am = (ch->am + (cur->am * (p1 * p2) % mod)) % mod;
                if (ch->n == 0) {
                    ch->n = cur->n + 1;
                    q.push(ch);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << ns[0][0][1].n - 1 << "\n" << ns[0][0][1].am << "\n";
    return 0;
}
